lastdenn_entrance_guard.name: Lastdenn Guard
lastdenn_entrance_guard.comment: WARNING: phraseId 100 is used in a conv condition.

text: Halt! The mayor has ordered me to stop anyone from passing through this town's entrance until 15:00.
Only those with official business in or from Lastdenn may pass here before then.
I'm sorry sir, but I have my orders.
I'm sorry sir, that's not how it works. Official business must be pre-approved by the mayor.
[GRAY](It's quite scandalous that the mayor would close this passage for profit like this, if you ask me...)

choices.text: [Diplomat 3] *Make a formal request in the name of the priest.*

text: Well... There aren't really. Our priest is publicly opposed to this closure. He says that anyone on a religious pilgrimage should be allowed to pass freely.
[GRAY](I think he does have a point there...)
Hmm... I suppose I can make an exception for our priest.
You may pass, but do not let word of this get out.
Guards! To me! I'm under attack!
It's after 15:00. The gate is open now. You may pass.
I allowed you to pass. Please do not let word of this get out.
Welcome to Lastdenn's Temple. I'm sister Margarita.
Do you want me to pray for you, so you can feel save on your journey?

choices.text: *You don't believe in her false god. Take your leave.*

text: Mighty Evdos, bless this traveler into savety.
